text:
asha_cs: FYI onboarding call with Nimbus ended — they're seeing intermittent 429s during SDK init, blocking their first-run tests.
pete_dev: can you paste the client logs and which SDK + version?
asha_cs: node sdk v0.9.2, logs show a rapid fanout of preflight calls when their service boots. snippet:

```
[2026-03-20T18:03:12Z] preflight: POST /v1/client/preflight 429 {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":2}
[2026-03-20T18:03:12Z] auth: token refresh triggered
[2026-03-20T18:03:13Z] preflight: POST /v1/client/preflight 429
[2026-03-20T18:03:14Z] worker#12 init -> preflight
```

maria_sdk: this looks like a classic preflight stampede — multiple workers all doing ephemeral token checks at once. do they spawn many short-lived workers? what orchestration are they using?
asha_cs: yes, serverless containers — each cold start does a preflight.

pete_dev: two quick mitigation steps from SDK side:
1) enable client-side preflight caching (ttl ~60s) so cold starts share the token
2) add jittered retry/backoff on 429s — example in Node:

```
// pseudo
async function preflight() {
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++){
    try { return await callPreflight() }
    catch(e){ if (e.code===429) await sleep((Math.pow(2,i)+random())*100) else throw e }
  }
}
```

maria_sdk: also set the env var REDWOOD_PRELIGHT_SPLAY=200-1000ms for serverless pools — we pushed a patch to v0.9.3 that adds a randomized splay on init.
sam_oncall: from infra side we can temporarily increase the account's burst window for their org_id while they ramp. that buys time while they implement caching. also recommend routing their warmup traffic to a single region to avoid cross-region throttles.
asha_cs: customer is worried about renewal if onboarding blocks. can we give a short-term workaround we can share in their ticket?

pete_dev: share these concrete steps to customer:
- pin SDK to v0.9.3 (has splay)
- enable SDK preflight cache: set REDWOOD_PREFLIGHT_CACHE_TTL=60
- implement exponential backoff with jitter on 429s
- if using containers, warm a single long-lived instance on deploy to amortize preflight

maria_sdk: curl example for preflight with cache header they can use in their warmup script:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/client/preflight \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "X-Client-Warmup: true"
```

rlimit-bot: Automated note: org:nimbus-org hit preflight rate limit threshold 3 times in last 10m. Suggested action: reduce preflight frequency or request temporary burst increase via support.

sam_oncall: I've opened a transient quota request for nimbus-org -> +3x preflight burst for 48h. ticket #S-2026-324 created.
asha_cs: perfect — i'll relay steps and the temporary quota. i'll ask SE to schedule a 30m session next week to walk them through warmup patterns. renewal risk: medium until they complete warmup changes.

pete_dev: one more prod-safe tip: if they can't change app quickly, add an edge-side warmup lambda that runs once per deploy to prime tokens.
maria_sdk: noted, will follow up with a short guide and a quick code example in the ticket.
asha_cs: thanks all. i'll close the loop with the customer and add the action items to the onboarding checklist.

asha_cs: action items: 1) customer pins v0.9.3 + enable cache 2) SRE transient burst applied (S-2026-324) 3) SE session scheduled — follow-up by Friday. :thumbsup:
